description: StyleMap keys (mu-* anchors extracted from styles-src/style-*.css by createStyleMap) that no component under default/ui ever emits as a class-context token, so build-styles.ts's generator never consumes them for any of the 8 styles. check-consumption.ts fails on any StyleMap key not consumed AND not listed here. Each entry needs a one-line reason verified against current default/ui source — do not bulk-add without checking.

entries.mu-alert-dialog-content-aria: CSS carries a separate -aria selector variant; our alert-dialog content expresses ARIA state via data-[state=]/aria-* attribute selectors in the class string itself, never a distinct mu-*-aria class.
entries.mu-alert-dialog-overlay-aria: same -aria pattern as mu-alert-dialog-content-aria; no distinct class token emitted.
entries.mu-checkbox-aria: same -aria pattern; checkbox expresses checked/disabled state via data-* attribute selectors on the mu-checkbox class, not a separate -aria class.
entries.mu-combobox-content-aria: same -aria pattern; combobox content has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-combobox-item-aria: same -aria pattern; combobox item has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-combobox-item-text: our combobox item has no distinct '-text' slot class; the item label renders as plain text inside the item element with no wrapping class.
entries.mu-command-item-aria: same -aria pattern; command item has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-command-shortcut-aria: same -aria pattern; command shortcut has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-context-menu-content-aria: same -aria pattern; context-menu content has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-context-menu-content-logical: CSS carries a separate -logical (RTL logical-property) selector variant; our context-menu content has no distinct -logical class token.
entries.mu-context-menu-sub-content-aria: same -aria pattern; context-menu sub-content has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-dialog-content-aria: same -aria pattern; dialog content has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-dialog-overlay-aria: same -aria pattern; dialog overlay has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-drawer-footer-base: our drawer.marko uses mu-drawer-footer, not a '-footer-base' variant; no such anchor exists in the component.
entries.mu-drawer-header-base: our drawer.marko uses mu-drawer-header, not a '-header-base' variant; no such anchor exists in the component.
entries.mu-drawer-popup: structural mismatch: our drawer has no 'popup' slot/anchor; the outer surface uses mu-drawer-content instead.
entries.mu-drawer-swipe-handle: structural mismatch: our drawer's drag handle uses mu-drawer-handle, not 'mu-drawer-swipe-handle'.
entries.mu-dropdown-menu-content-aria: same -aria pattern; dropdown-menu content has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-dropdown-menu-content-logical: same -logical pattern; dropdown-menu content has no distinct -logical class token.
entries.mu-dropdown-menu-sub-content-aria: same -aria pattern; dropdown-menu sub-content has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-field-label-aria: same -aria pattern; field label has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-hover-card-content-aria: same -aria pattern; hover-card content has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-hover-card-content-logical: same -logical pattern; hover-card content has no distinct -logical class token.
entries.mu-label-aria: same -aria pattern; label has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-menu-translucent-aria: same -aria pattern applied to the shared mu-menu-translucent allowlisted token; no distinct -aria class exists anywhere it is used (dropdown-menu, context-menu, menubar, select).
entries.mu-menubar-content-logical: same -logical pattern; menubar content has no distinct -logical class token.
entries.mu-navigation-menu-popup: structural mismatch: our navigation-menu has no 'popup' slot; content surfaces use mu-navigation-menu-content/-viewport instead.
entries.mu-navigation-menu-positioner: structural mismatch: our navigation-menu has no 'positioner' slot/anchor at all.
entries.mu-popover-content-aria: same -aria pattern; popover content has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-popover-content-logical: same -logical pattern; popover content has no distinct -logical class token.
entries.mu-progress-label: structural mismatch: our progress.marko's label span uses data-slot="progress-label" plus plain utilities, no mu-* class.
entries.mu-progress-track: structural mismatch: our progress.marko's track div uses data-slot="progress-track" plus plain utilities, no mu-* class.
entries.mu-progress-value: structural mismatch: our progress.marko's value-text span uses data-slot="progress-value" plus plain utilities, no mu-* class.
entries.mu-radio-group-item-aria: same -aria pattern; radio-group item has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-select-content-aria: same -aria pattern; select content has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-select-content-logical: same -logical pattern; select content has no distinct -logical class token.
entries.mu-select-empty-aria: same -aria pattern; select empty-state has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-select-item-aria: same -aria pattern; select item has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-select-item-text: our select item has no distinct '-text' slot class; the item label renders as plain text inside the item element with no wrapping class.
entries.mu-select-value: structural mismatch: our select.marko's value span uses data-slot="select-value" only, no mu-* class at all (verified select.marko:115).
entries.mu-select-value-aria: same -aria pattern layered on mu-select-value, which itself has no class token to begin with.
entries.mu-separator: our separator.marko has no mu-* anchor at all — root div uses data-slot="separator" plus plain utility classes only (verified full file contents).
entries.mu-separator-horizontal: see mu-separator — component carries no mu-* anchors; horizontal/vertical variants are expressed via data-orientation + Tailwind data-horizontal:/data-vertical: variants, not separate classes.
entries.mu-sidebar-menu-button-aria: same -aria pattern; sidebar menu-button has no separate -aria class token (state expressed via data-active etc. attribute selectors).
entries.mu-switch-aria: same -aria pattern; mu-switch itself IS consumed (switch.marko:83) but there is no separate mu-switch-aria class anywhere.
entries.mu-switch-thumb-aria: same -aria pattern; mu-switch-thumb itself IS consumed (switch.marko:90) but there is no separate mu-switch-thumb-aria class.
entries.mu-table-cell-aria: same -aria pattern; table cell has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-table-head-aria: same -aria pattern; table head cell has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-table-row-aria: same -aria pattern; table row has no separate -aria class token (selection state expressed via data-state/aria-selected attribute selectors).
entries.mu-tabs-trigger-aria: same -aria pattern; mu-tabs-trigger itself IS consumed (tabs.marko:110) but there is no separate mu-tabs-trigger-aria class.
entries.mu-toggle-aria: same -aria pattern; toggle has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-tooltip-arrow-logical: same -logical pattern; tooltip arrow has no distinct -logical class token.
entries.mu-tooltip-content-aria: same -aria pattern; tooltip content has no separate -aria class token.
entries.mu-tooltip-content-logical: same -logical pattern; tooltip content has no distinct -logical class token.
